

== Biography ==

Mary J. Pierce was the first wife of Moses Thomas Glasgow. The inspected family-history typescript attributed to William Melanchthon Glasgow states that Moses and Mary married on 5 November 1839 and had three children: [[Glasgow-2357|Lois Ladd Glasgow]], [[Glasgow-2356|Robert Finley Glasgow]], and an infant John Cameron Glasgow. That infant is not identified with [[Glasgow-466|John Cameron Glasgow]], whose retained profile birth year is 1820. Mary died on 14 March 1846. Moses later married [[Thompson-63146|Martha Thompson]] in 1848; Martha was Robert’s stepmother, not his biological mother.

Mary’s exact birth and death records have not been inspected. The retrospective typescript contains minor date errors, including Mary’s age stated as 26 despite the retained approximate 1821 birth, so no vital fields are changed.
